name: Singapore Changi Airport

ppr.v: prior permission needed only for aircraft without radio
ppr.quote: Prior permission required for aircraft not equipped with radiotelephony.

slots.v: Changi is slot coordinated; every non-scheduled flight needs a slot from the Changi Slot Coordinator (Changi Airport Group), requested at least 72 hours before the flight
slots.quote: shall submit their slot requests to the Changi Slot Coordinator no later than 72 hours prior

missing: runway (AD 2.12 still not readable, see unreadable)
notes: Arrival window converted from 0900-1559 UTC to Singapore time (UTC+8, no daylight saving). The AIP SUP 002/2026 (sg-sup-2026-002) gives RWY 02R/20L a full-length declared distance of 4,000 m but no width, and says that runway was closed to civil use from 19 Feb to 5 Aug 2026; the longest runway and widths were not verified. The AIP page read is valid from 09 Jul 2026 (folder 15-JUL-2026); the fetch tool only read the page up to AD 2.11. Re-researched 2026-10-29: Slots: AIP GEN 1.2 para 2.1-2.5 (page GEN 1.2-1 dated 02 Oct 2025, reprinted in AMDT 03/2026, unchanged there) says Changi is slot coordinated with Changi Airport Group as Slot Coordinator; requests go by email to the Changi Slot Coordinator as a Slot Clearance Request, or a General (Aviation) Clearance Request (GCR) for operators without a 2-letter IATA code; ground time should be limited to 24 hours from the arrival slot; requests under 24 hours' notice must also be notified to CAG Airside Operations. IMPORTANT for business jets: AD 2.2 remarks (valid from 09 Jul 2026) say Changi is not available to non-scheduled civil aircraft of 40 seats or below except in special circumstances (second sentence: 'Aircraft larger than the above category shall not plan their arrival between 0900-1559UTC'), so most business jets are expected to use Seletar; converted to UTC+8, no daylight saving. AMDT 03/2026 checklist dates AD 2.WSSS-1 and -12 at 19 Mar 2026 and AD 2.WSSS-35 to -49 at 14 May 2026, so later WSSS pages (AD 2.20/2.21) changed in May 2026 and have not been read. The AIP page read (same edition as sg-aip-wsss) was opened at the 09-JUL-2026 folder URL; the text extract still stops at AD 2.11. The obstacle chart (AOC Type A, AMDT 03/2025) shows declared distances of 4000 m for RWY 02L/20R but the mapping per direction and width were unclear, so not used.
